method: Each mutant replaces every occurrence of `old` with `new` in one file of a fresh `git archive <commit> .syzygy` extraction, then runs `command` from that extraction's root. A mutant is killed only when it replaced at least one occurrence, the command exits nonzero, and its output contains `expected`. Generator mutants (M*) break the repaired code and must fail --selftest on the named case; input mutants (I*) change the corpus, the index or the shared phase-rule list and must fail --check.

"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-82ci: each is applied to a fresh copy of .syzygy/
at the given commit; the expected check must fail on its own predicate."""
import json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

REPO = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
COMMIT = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
C = ".syzygy/governance/contracts/candidates"
GEN = f"{C}/scripts/build_contract_index.py"
VER = f"{C}/scripts/verify_final_prespec.py"
README = f"{C}/rfcs/RFC-0002/README.md"
INDEX = f"{C}/05-CONTRACT-INDEX.yaml"

MUTANTS = [
    # (id, kind, file, old, new, command, expected substring in output)
    ("M1", "generator", GEN,
     "lines.append(f\"    {STATUS_KEY}: {status_projection(e['status'])}\")",
     "lines.append(\"    status_source: owner-act-record\")",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: a divergent status_source renders [Unknown]"),
    ("M2", "generator", GEN,
     "PHASE_RULES = frozenset(PHASE_RULE_CLAUSES)",
     "PHASE_RULES = {\"RFC6-28\", \"RFC7-38\", \"RFC8-32\", \"RFC9-52\", \"RFC10-16\", \"RFC11-12\"}",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: the indexed phase-rule set is exactly the shared list"),
    ("M3", "generator", GEN,
     "\"# NOT AUTHORITY. This candidate-lane projection binds nothing and states no\",",
     "\"# This candidate-lane projection states no\",",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: the header carries the non-authority banner"),
    ("M4", "generator", GEN,
     "+ \"; \".join(f\"{', '.join(secs)} {kind}\" for kind, secs in by_kind.items())",
     "+ \"see the code\"",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: the header states every section-kind and phase rule"),
    ("M5", "generator", GEN,
     "findings += [f\"STATUS MISMATCH: {line}\" for line in status_mismatches(generated)]",
     "findings += []",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: --check fails on a mismatch even when the committed index agrees"),
    ("M6", "generator", GEN,
     "    if len(values) == 1 and None not in values:\n        return values.pop()",
     "    if values - {None}:\n        return sorted(values - {None})[0]",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: a divergent status_source renders [Unknown]"),
    ("M7", "generator", GEN,
     "        return after != copied(rel, lambda t: t)",
     "        return after != base",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: a no-op edit does not register as a change"),
    ("I1", "input", README,
     "\nstatus_source: owner-act-record",
     "\nstatus_source: self-declared",
     "--check", "STATUS MISMATCH: status_source: [Unknown] — modules disagree: owner-act-record, self-declared"),
    ("I2", "input", INDEX,
     "{id: RFC1-33, module: RFC-0001-project-graph-identity-state-planes.md, kind: phase-rule}",
     "{id: RFC1-33, module: RFC-0001-project-graph-identity-state-planes.md, kind: normative}",
     "--check", "DRIFT: 05-CONTRACT-INDEX.yaml differs from regeneration"),
    ("I3", "input", VER,
     "PHASE_RULE_CLAUSES = [\"RFC1-33\", ",
     "PHASE_RULE_CLAUSES = [",
     "--check", "DRIFT: 05-CONTRACT-INDEX.yaml differs from regeneration"),
    ("I4", "input", INDEX,
     "# NOT AUTHORITY. This candidate-lane projection binds nothing and states no\n",
     "",
     "--check", "DRIFT: 05-CONTRACT-INDEX.yaml differs from regeneration"),
]

results = []
for mid, kind, rel, old, new, flag, expect in MUTANTS:
    tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"82ci-{mid}-"))
    try:
        archive = subprocess.run(["git", "archive", COMMIT, ".syzygy"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
        subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(tmp)], input=archive, check=True)
        target = tmp / rel
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        occurrences = text.count(old)
        target.write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tmp / GEN), flag], cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = run.stdout + run.stderr
        killed = occurrences >= 1 and run.returncode != 0 and expect in out
        results.append({"id": mid, "kind": kind, "file": rel, "old": old, "new": new,
                        "occurrencesReplaced": occurrences, "command": f"python3 {GEN} {flag}",
                        "expected": expect, "exitCode": run.returncode, "killed": killed,
                        "outputTail": out.strip().splitlines()[-3:]})
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)

print(json.dumps({"commit": COMMIT, "mutants": results,
                  "killed": sum(r["killed"] for r in results), "total": len(results)}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
